Record the current setting, expected security improvement, application checks and exact
recovery method. Choose the pilot first and schedule a short maintenance window.
For attack-surface-reduction rules, use an appropriate audit-first pilot with the documented
management method and plan capability. Do not flip every rule to Block on all servers or assume
Check: One bounded change has a baseline, owner, acceptance checks and rollback decision.
